svg.text: Euclid’s Steps Change the Pair (x, y) Without Changing the Strip CD(x, y)
Loop invariant: CD(x, y) = CD(y, x mod y), and since Div(0) = ℕ, stopping at y = 0 forces Div(x) = CD(a, b)
Why y = 0 Proves x : Gcd(12, 8): Because Div(0) = ℕ (every d divides 0 = d·0), intersecting with Div(0) changes nothing!
Chain of equal strips: CD(12, 8) = CD(8, 4) = CD(4, 0) = Div(4) ∩ ℕ = Div(4). Therefore x = 4 inhabits Gcd(12, 8).
